formative_worksheets.title: Numerals 0-50 Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute mid-unit check confirming B1.2 (compose/decompose) before Day 4 introduces compare/order.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative assessment distinct from lesson worksheets. Lets the teacher see which children can fluently decompose numbers to 50 in multiple ways.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can decompose any number to 50 in two different ways.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can decompose any number to 50 in two different ways.
header.character_watermark: Otto in the top-right corner with a magnifying glass — the 'check-in' Otto. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Show 32 in TWO different ways. Use base-ten rods.
prompts.visual_layout: Two blank boxes side by side, each ~3in × 2in, with light-grey outlines. Above box A: 'Way 1'. Above box B: 'Way 2'.

image_placeholders.description: Two blank decomposition boxes in B&W line-art. Each ~3in × 2in. Headers 'Way 1' and 'Way 2'. Below each box, '32 = ___ + ___'.
image_placeholders.placement: Top half of the page; full-width.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_TWO_DECOMP_BOXES: keywords (decomposition, rods, 32) name what the boxes ask for.

prompts.answer_key: Two different decompositions of 32 (e.g., 30+2 and 16+16, or 30+2 and 25+7). Drawn with base-ten rods or written as equations.

prompts.prompt: Look at the number line. Some numbers are missing. Fill them in.
prompts.visual_layout: A horizontal number-line strip 0 to 50 with cells empty at positions 7, 18, 23, 35, 41. The child fills the missing numbers.

image_placeholders.description: A horizontal number-line strip in B&W line-art spanning page width (~7in). 51 cells (0-50). Cells 7, 18, 23, 35, 41 are blank with dotted outlines. Other cells show their numerals.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_FILL_NUMBER_LINE: keywords (number-line, missing) name what the line shows.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about composing and decomposing? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Three faces in a horizontal row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row, each ~1.5in across. Smile, neutral, frown. Below each, the labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Compare with prompts 1 and 2 results.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Score guide: 2/2 (decomp + number-line) + confident self-rating = ready for Lesson 4. 1/2 = brief 1:1 conference. 0/2 = small-group reteach with rod-moving.

reflection_sheet.title: My Number Friends Reflection
reflection_sheet.purpose: End-of-unit metacognition. Children look back at their week of number work, rate themselves, name a favourite manipulative, name a struggle, set a forward goal.
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Lila with a Junior Number Friend certificate in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Number Friend? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Three star-rating ovals. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels below.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W line-art. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars left to right. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Number Friend!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (counter, stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.
prompts.visual_layout: A 4-row YES/NO table. Questions: 'I estimated and counted to 50.', 'I made and broke numbers.', 'I compared and ordered.', 'I shared fairly between 2 or 4.'

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table in B&W line-art. Each row has a question label on the left and YES/NO oval bubbles on the right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.visual_layout: Four manipulative icons in a row: button jar, base-ten rods, number line, pizza fractions. Below each, a circle.

image_placeholders.description: Four manipulative illustrations in a row in B&W line-art: button jar, base-ten rods, number line, pizza fractions. Each ~1in × 1in with a selection bubble below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (jar, rods, line, pizza) name the four manipulatives.

prompts.visual_layout: Three tricky-moment cards in a row: bigger-bottom-smaller-piece (1/2 vs 1/4), tens-vs-ones compare (41 vs 38), partner-pair flexibility (32 in many ways).

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: pizza halves vs fourths. Card B: numerals 41 vs 38. Card C: 32 with multiple decompositions. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (pizza, compare, decomposition) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?
prompts.visual_layout: Three forward-goal cards: numbers to 100, addition to 50, fractions like 1/8.

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: numbers 100 with a question mark. Card B: addition equation 25+25. Card C: pizza divided into 8 slices.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (numbers, addition, pizza) name the three forward-goal cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the very end of Lesson 5. Allow children to take home as a self-assessment artifact. Compare each child's reflection with their summative score: high reflection + high summative = ready for next unit; mismatches signal confidence-building or remediation needs.
